headline.before: I build the backend that keeps AI

lede: Final-year computer engineer in Mumbai. I work on LLM agents, Django APIs and real-time systems, mostly the parts that have to hold up after the demo.

paragraphs: I build the backend side of products that use LLMs: Django and DRF APIs, WebSockets for live updates, and the code around the model call. Getting a demo to answer once is the easy part. I'm more interested in what comes after, when the provider rate-limits you, the prompt is missing context, or a request just hangs.
I work from the failure cases out. I read the logs, write down what broke and why, and would rather ship a feature that degrades cleanly than one that only works on a good day.
